evidence: 2026-09-30: driven through the Agent Vault proxy with this recipe, with browser egress through the owner's tunnel on a US network. On app.clickup.com/signup the form (Full name, Work email, Password, Sign up with Email) took the vault login's values through all three selectors, and submit answered that the email is already registered: the account had been created with the same vault login in an earlier session. A fresh sign-in on app.clickup.com/login with those credentials was accepted, then asked for a code sent by email, which the account owner entered in a handoff (outcome solved), and the session reached ClickUp's onboarding signed in. The original signup's own steps were not re-observed in this run.
gotchas: The form has a Full name box (role=textbox named Full name) besides the email and password; Sign up with Email stays disabled until they are filled.
Signing in from a new browser asks for a code sent by email after the password ("enter the code we sent"); it belongs to the account owner: hand it off.

2026-10-12: there are two checkboxes under the form; the second (form input[type=checkbox] >> nth=1) is the Terms consent and must be ticked. The first submit click can return a 401 with no message; a second click went through.
2026-10-12: after signup ClickUp emails the account a 4-digit code (four single-digit inputs); it belongs to the account owner, hand it off.
2026-10-12: onboarding is Personal/Work/School, then Next or Skip on each step; one step lists features (Docs, Tasks, Projects, ...) and keeps Next disabled until one is picked; it ends with Finish.
